admittedInterpretations.text: Capability is read from what can be absorbed, practiced, expressed and repeatedly carried.

For capability and expression, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 41.7%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Resource pattern path and Eating God pattern path and is modified by relationships between pillar positions such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 4 themes considered across the chart, so this is best read together with the rest of the chart.
Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility and relationships can circulate as one system.

For life operation, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 41.7%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Resource pattern path and Eating God pattern path and is modified by relationships between pillar positions such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 4 themes considered across the chart, so this is best read together with the rest of the chart.
Work is read here as the way output, responsibility, resources and learning are organized into a usable role.

For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 25%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Indirect Wealth. It also connects to Eating God pattern path and is modified by relationships between pillar positions such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 3 themes considered across the chart, so this is best read together with the rest of the chart.
Wealth is read as the chart’s resource flow: what can be produced, managed, exchanged and protected.

For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 16.7%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Peer, and Indirect Wealth. It also connects to Eating God pattern path and is modified by relationships between pillar positions such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression.
Relationships are read through recurring relationships between pillar positions between self-position, rules, resources and support, not through a single spouse label.

For relationships, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 25%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Peer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by relationships between pillar positions such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 2 themes considered across the chart, so this is best read together with the rest of the chart.
Pressure is read from standards and control together with the support available to carry them.

For pressure and responsibility, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 25%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Peer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.

tensionSignals.text: Reliability still depends on whether roots 1, support 2 and output cost 4 can work together over time.
The key is not which function wins permanently, but whether support, output, resources and responsibility can return to a sustainable circulation across changing periods.
Career structure can change with role, organization and timing. This describes work dynamics rather than fixing one profession into a guaranteed success-or-failure outcome.
Resource structure describes how money, opportunity and exchange enter the chart; it is not an income promise. Real outcomes still depend on choices, markets, responsibilities and timing.

Relationship structure is best used to observe interaction style, boundaries and recurring relationships between pillar positions rather than to predict marriage, separation or one fixed partner outcome.
The carrying side currently shows support, output and pressure are mixed, so pressure should be read against visible support 2 and pressure 1, not Officer count alone.

tensionSignals.text: 能力是否稳定，要继续看根气 1、生扶 2 与输出成本 4 能不能长期配合。
生活运行的关键不是哪一组永远占上风，而是支持、输出、资源与责任能否在不同阶段重新找到可持续的循环。
事业结构会随角色、组织环境与阶段而改变；这里说明的是工作运行方式，不把它直接写成某个职业的固定成败结论。
资源结构说明钱、机会与交换怎样进入命盘，不等同实际收入承诺；现实结果仍取决于选择、市场、责任与时间条件。
关系结构更适合观察互动方式、边界与反复柱位关系，不把它直接翻译成结婚、分手或某一种伴侣结果。
承载侧目前呈「支持、外泄与压力并见」，所以压力要同时看可用支持 2 与受克 1，不能只看官杀数量。
时间层用于界定对照范围，不能据此认定某件事已经发生或必然发生。
流年层用于界定观察范围；本次读取不把具体事件判断为机会或预警。

It also connects to Resource pattern path and Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and is modified by relationships between pillar positions such as outer context ↔ environment and self anchor ↔ later expression. 事业主题看的是表达产出、规则责任、资源交换与学习支持怎样组织成可持续的工作方式。
就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 25%），主要连接到偏印、食神、正财。同时可连接到财格路径、正官格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位柱位关系修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。
财富主题看的是资源怎样被产出、管理、交换与保留，而不是把一个财星直接等同于财富结果。
就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 25%），主要连接到食神、正财、正官。同时可连接到财格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位柱位关系修正。它与整盘 1 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。
关系主题看自我位置、规则、资源与支持怎样在不同关系柱位关系里反复出现，而不是把某一柱直接等同某个人。
就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「资源与交换」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 25%），主要连接到偏印、正财、正官。同时可连接到财格路径、正官格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位柱位关系修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。
压力主题把规则与受克放在可用支持和承载条件里一起读。
就「压力与责任」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 16.7%），主要连接到偏印、食神、正官。同时可连接到正官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。
